pages.text: Requires being Branded with $(l)99.5%$() Branded Progress. Once active, the $(l)Provocation$() curse no longer turns neutral mobs hostile. Your other curses stay.
Craft with a $(l)Golden Apple$(), $(l)Golden Carrots$(), $(l)Flowers$() (any kind), and an $(l)Oblivion Stone$(). Also found in Stronghold, End City, and Ominous Trial Chamber loot.
